control_sql: select d.EFFECTITBAL e,sum(d.STRQTY) q,count(*) n from trndtl d join trnhdr h on h.CONO=d.CONO and h.STRNO=d.STRNO and h.OPCODE=d.OPCODE and h.DOCNO=d.DOCNO where d.CONO=1 and d.STRNO=1 and d.STS='A' and h.STS='A' and d.EFFECTITBAL in ('A','S') and d.DOCDT>='2026-01-01' and d.DOCDT<='2026-02-28' group by d.EFFECTITBAL

jan.sql: select d.ITNO,d.EFFECTITBAL e,sum(d.STRQTY) q from trndtl d join trnhdr h on h.CONO=d.CONO and h.STRNO=d.STRNO and h.OPCODE=d.OPCODE and h.DOCNO=d.DOCNO where d.CONO=1 and d.STRNO=1 and d.STS='A' and h.STS='A' and d.EFFECTITBAL in ('A','S') and d.DOCDT<'2026-02-01' group by d.ITNO,d.EFFECTITBAL

feb.sql: select d.ITNO,d.EFFECTITBAL e,sum(d.STRQTY) q from trndtl d join trnhdr h on h.CONO=d.CONO and h.STRNO=d.STRNO and h.OPCODE=d.OPCODE and h.DOCNO=d.DOCNO where d.CONO=1 and d.STRNO=1 and d.STS='A' and h.STS='A' and d.EFFECTITBAL in ('A','S') and d.DOCDT<'2026-03-01' group by d.ITNO,d.EFFECTITBAL
